claim:
Let \(X=\ell_2-\ell_1\) be the real Day--James plane with
\[
\|(s,t)\|_X=
\begin{cases}
\sqrt{s^2+t^2},&st\ge0,\\
|s|+|t|,&st\le0.
\end{cases}
\]
For \(\varepsilon\in[0,1)\), write \(u\perp_D^\varepsilon v\) when
\[
\|u+\lambda v\|_X\ge\sqrt{1-\varepsilon^2}\,\|u\|_X
\qquad(\lambda\in\mathbb R).
\]
Then the least \(\varepsilon\) for which
\[
x\perp_B y\Longrightarrow y\perp_D^\varepsilon x
\qquad(x,y\in X)
\]
is
\[
\varepsilon_D(X)=\frac1{\sqrt2}.
\]
Equivalently,
\[
\inf_{\substack{x,y\in S_X\\x\perp_B y}}
\inf_{\lambda\in\mathbb R}\|y+\lambda x\|_X
=
\frac1{\sqrt2}.
\]
Equality is attained by
\[
x=(1,0),
\qquad
y=\frac{(1,1)}{\sqrt2},
\]
and by the norm symmetries.
integrity: The proof exhausts all three unit-sphere strata and computes the reverse line distance exactly from annihilating dual functionals. The sharp value is realized at a nonsmooth coordinate-axis junction.
scientific_limitations: The exact value concerns the modified Dragomir approximate relation on the real two-dimensional Day--James space ell_2-ell_1. The distinct Chmielinski approximate-symmetry parameter and a full ell_p-ell_1 parameter profile are not determined.
title: Sharp Dragomir approximate-symmetry parameter of the Day--James ell_2--ell_1 plane
